If this quest is your first visit to Kalimdor, as it is for many alliance warlocks, then here is a suggested route that will allow you to pick up some crucial flight points:

1. If you start in Stormwind, take the tram to Ironforge and pick up the flightpoint there.

2. Get a portal to Darnassus, or find a warlock in darnassus that can summon you.  Mages must be level 50 to cast portal: Darnassus.

3. Leave Darnassus via Rutheran village, pick up the flight point there.

4. Take the ferry from Rutheran to Auberdine.

5. Grab Auberdine Flight Point.

6. Take the boat from Auberdine to Menethil harbor (directly across from the one you arrived on)

7. Pick up Menethil Flight Point.

8. Take the other boat from Menethil to Theramore and grab the flight point there.

9. Swim north from Theramore to the Barrens.

10.  Stop by Ratchet and grab that flight point.

11.  Go speak to the quest NPC

12.  If you want, you can also take the boat from Ratchet to Booty Bay and grab the flight point there to save yourself the run across STV later.

This may seem like a lot of traveling, but you're cutting out a lot of run around it would take to get these flight paths the "traditional" way.  By doing this you've made it much easier to get between the major towns whenever you need to.
It's a bit tough if your on a pvp server. If so I suggest going along the mountains. there are paths at the top with minimal creatures and you can't be spotted from the road.

You could, since you're a warlock, even make this one step easier.

Fly to Westfall.
Run to the coast, near lighthouse.
Swim to Booty Bay.
Keep Unending Breath cast and swim under enough water so that horde will not see you.
Climb out at Booty Bay and get FP, take ship to Ratchet and run to Takar.

I think this would be a more dangerous path, though. Except for the swimming part.

[b]EASIEST WAY[/b]

Note:  If you don't already have the gryphon route to Menethil, read one of the other posts about how to get there.

From the docks in Menethil, take the boat from the [b]north[/b] dock to Auberdeen.  Once you exit the boat and get to the end of the dock, you're inside the Inn.  [b]Make this Inn your home[/b].  Exit the south door of the Inn (up the ramp) and click the Gryphon Master to add the flight route.  Now go back to the dock, taking the same boat you came in on (south dock, to Menethil).

Once back in Menethil, go to the [b]south[/b] dock and take the boat to Theramore Isle.  In Theramore, head straight off the dock into town, and click the Gryphon Master there (on the left side of the road).  Head north and curve around the castle to get to the town's exit.

Just outside the town gates, make a right through the graveyard onto the beach.  [b]Staying on the sand[/b], run north up the beach until the beach curves sharply left (west), where you'll see an island ahead of you that's filled with Mirefins.  Cast Unending Breath and swim Northeast.  Looking on your minimap you'll see ahead of you two islands.  Swim north between those two islands.

I killed five more Laborers for the last book. Giving 17 laborers yield 7 books, and an overall Laborer drop rate of 41% from the Laborers, total.

Good drop rate. I found all books easily without any separate kobold grinding required outside of finishing the three old slaying quests [i](10 vermin, 10 workers, 12 laborers)[/i].

This quest is part of a new chain that leads you outside of the starting area and involves objectives in the broader Elwynn Forest area. It's very much worth completing, as the final part rewards you with [b]green quality weapons[/b].

[b]EDIT: Apparently people are saying the drop rate is now poor as of launch. I have yet to confirm this myself.[/b]
The title of this quest is a reference to [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elmer_Fudd]Elmer Fudd[/url] who is famous for hunting "wascawwy wabbits".

91743.description: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.
91743.name: Rascally Rodents
91743.objective: Retrieve 8 Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.

comments.body:
Kelsey is located [b]in front of the kobold cave[/b].

The next part involves killing a [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=248362/shinyfinder-narf#map]level 3 elite kobold[/url] inside the cave, but he shouldn't present you with any real problems. He uses Fireball and Frost Armor.

The [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=91777/rare-books]final part[/url] of this new quest chain rewards you with green quality weapons.

91745.description: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.
91745.name: Mining Consultant
91745.objective: Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.

comments.body: [npc=248362] is a level 3 elite inside the kobold cave. Take the [b]second right turn[/b] and you'll find him. The quest suggest you do this with a friend, but don't be afraid to try it alone if you're level 4+.

91752.description:
Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.
Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.
91752.name: The Big Picture
91752.objective: Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf. Bring the sack to Marshal McBride just inside Northshire's Abbey.

comments.body:
[url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=248415/tordrin-sternblade#map]Tordrin Sternblade[/url] is a Hunter trainer located behind the abbey, next to the stables.

After chatting with Tordrin and accepting the next part, you will be given a kobold tracker. Use the item and start running towards Goldshire. While you're making your way, look at your minimap and go click each kobold track you see.

91758.description:
You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.
Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.
91758.name: Follow That Kobold!
91758.objective: Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.

comments.body:
Seems bugged right now. The item says "Target level too low" and the buff it is supposed to give has "Requires level 35", which seems a bit high for a level 4 quest...
You can still complete the quest by just looking for and clicking 6 kobold tracks, just south of Northsire.

Another [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elmer_Fudd]Elmer Fudd[/url] reference from Bugs Bunny cartoons, "Shhh. Be vewy, vewy quiet, I'm hunting wabbits"

Also, if you're having trouble seeing the tracks while the buff is bugged, you can turn down your graphics settings to remove ground clutter and see them more clearly. They're near trees south of the starting area.

Use the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=247970/kobold-tracking-kit]item[/url], it grants a [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=1246031/hunting-kobolds]buff[/url] that allows you to detect the quest objectives in your minimap. The tracks are mostly found [b]next to trees as you exit Northshire Valley and start running towards Goldshire[/b].

91772.description:
Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.
Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.
91772.name: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds
91772.objective: Follow the kobold tracks and report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire with your findings and the Kobold Tracking Kit.

comments.body: The elementals book drops off named kobold named Nimsy (not the other one named Goldtooth). Enter in the top entrance of the mine, and from the large room in the mine, go east and curve north up the stairs. He's up there with some henchmen. Probably can't solo at appropriate level.

Note that, after the quest, the [item=279936] remains in your inventory as a 6-slot bag.

[s]Also, note that the [u]sale[/u] price (almost 9s) is much higher than other 6-slot bags so you might consider selling and buying something less expensive.[/s]

Sadly, the value of the [item=279936] was reduced to 62c (less than a standard 6-slot bag so best to keep it.

91775.description:
While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.
Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!
91775.name: Book Return
91775.objective:
Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.
Provided item:

92124.description:
We need to take stock of how many books are missing!
Go talk to my useless assistant, Daniel. He can do a quick inventory and let us know how serious the problem is.
He's obsessed with the various trade professions in Elwynn Forest. The boy keeps focusing on those instead of his important work helping me.
Don't let him prattle on about tradeskills, and find out what's happened to my books!
92124.name: Book Inventory
92124.objective: Speak to Daniel, Brother Paxton's assistant in the library.

comments.body: Seems like you can no longer pick this up as Tauren? Went to Shen'dar but no quest.

92514.description:
You've got that "Windshaper" air about you. Something about how I can feel a tiny bit of static on my skin when near someone spirit-touched that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident Windshaper elder, Illaya Amberwind. She's just outside, near the center of town.
Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.
92514.name: Welcome to Shen'dar Village
92514.objective: Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.

comments.body: *beta* You must complete the breadcrumb quest [quest=93461] before this quest is available.

The title of this quest is clearly a reference to the Star Trek original series, season 2, episode 13, [url=https://memory-alpha.fandom.com/wiki/The_Trouble_with_Tribbles_(episode)]The Trouble with Tribbles[/url].

92515.description:
As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. It would be a mercy for us to cull their numbers now rather than after some tragedy occurs.
Bring me a dozen or so of their pelts. I can turn them into all sorts of goods that will be of aid to the village.
92515.name: The Problem With Prideclaws
92515.objective: Collect 10 Prideclaw Pelts from the Prideclaws in Shen'dar Highlands.

comments.body: Do you have to be a Tauren to get thisbag,. or can any Horde character get it?
You do not be tauren to get this quest, done with a troll mage.  Have fun getting a free bag.

95805.description:
The sun and the moon, An'she and Mu'sha, are not part of our world like the elements, yet their light gives us life, guidance, and hope.
We pay respect to the spirits of the world, and so we pay respect to the twins as well.
If you would show your respect, take this smoldering incense and bring it to a shrine in the hills to the southeast, overlooking the mesa, south of the quilboar. Be quick, so that you can reach the shrine before the incense burns away.
Don't get it wet!
95805.name: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha
95805.objective: Carry the Smoldering Incense to the shrine of An'she and Mu'sha in the southeastern hills before the incense burns to ash in ten minutes!

comments.body: How do they fly without feathers?
took me 18 kills so I'd guess 33% drop rate
Took about 50 kills for all 6. Not a nice drop rate.

96107.description:
A hunter goes through more arrows in her lifetime than there are stars in the sky.
Personally, I make mine by hand. I only trust my own work.
The coarse feathers of the nearby buzzards make for excellent fletching. Would you aid me by collecting a few?
96107.name: Feathers for Fletching
96107.objective: Bring 6 Plains Buzzard Feathers to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

96108.description:
Arrows are always essential, but sometimes you need something more potent to take down your prey.
This is where poison coatings come into play. They ruin the meat, but if you need something dead, they do the job.
Poisons can either be brewed or, if you are brave, gathered. You strike me as the latter.
The vipers by the pools to the south produce a powerful venom. If I have estimated you correctly, I think you could collect some of it.
96108.name: Poison Tips
96108.objective: Bring 4 samples of Glade Viper Venom to Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

96109.description:
As important as a hunter's weapons is her quiver. A good quiver holds many arrows, while not being so large as to slow the wearer down. It must be durable, and fit snugly onto the body.
Around here, there is no better material for a quiver than the pelts of lions. They are already well-suited for the life of a hunter on the plains.
The lions gather on a hill to the south. You can see it from here. Please, bring me their pelts.
96109.name: A Hunter's Quiver
96109.objective: Gather 6 Prized Lion Hides for Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar.

comments.body: This area can be accessed from Stonetalon Mountains via Malaka'jin (path starting about 73.2, 95.7), or from Mulgore (40.1, 17.3). And Desolace (77.2, 35.8).

In the early going of Forever, green silk bags (12 slots) can be had for less than 1g while silk reagent bags are close to 2g.  Take the reagent bag as your reward (if you have a purpose for it, of course).

96260.description:
Have you heard what befell the burial ground at Gloomrise? Giant spiders--rumored to have a venom so strong that it can wake the dead--have spread like wildfire. Nasty business, if you ask me.
One of the scouts dispatched to investigate returned half dead and covered in an incredibly resilient, crystalline spider silk. I harvested what I could, but I would highly value more samples of this silk for additional study.
Bring me more of this crystalline silk and I will reward you.
96260.name: Stronger than Steel
96260.objective: Gather 3 strands of Crystalline Silk from Gloomrise Spinners.

comments.body: Looks like trash on the ground, near and inside tents
[b]Usually found near tents, outside of them, not inside a tent.[/b]
You will be looking for silver bolts and parts lying on the ground in the area. A full quest guide and walkthrough can be found here https://youtu.be/MVWHURorWuo

This quest is available to [b]both factions[/b].

This is one of the easiest ways to earn an [b]8 slot bag[/b] early on. Go [b]up the hill[/b] and search around the pirate camps for [b]nuts and bolts[/b]. If you can loot any through walls, you won't always even need to fight for them.

Alliance players heading out to Wailing Caverns can quickly finish this quest, then complete parts of the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=79008/and-that-note-you-found]sleeping bag quest chain[/url] for a [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=221498/old-toolbox]12 slot bag[/url], and then finally head out to the dungeon for 2 more potential 10-slotters [i]([url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=6446/snakeskin-bag]1[/url], [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=918/deviate-hide-pack]2[/url])[/i] in one [b]massive[/b] bag extravaganza. The only small problem remains logistics...

Other [b]new[/b] 8-slotters include:
[ul][li][item=5603] (Alliance only)[/li]
[li][item=1537] (Alliance only)[/li]
[li][item=5762] (70 Tailoring)[/li][/ul]

You can find the path up to the mountain at /way 63.7, 44.2, and/or /way 63.5, 45.5

The [item=277331] will be scattered around the camp in big numbers.

Bugged. The first groups of parts I came across were inside tents that my troll character was too tall to enter. No matter how hard I tried, my troll could not get past the entrance of the tent in order to be able to reach the parts. Very careless game design, and a basic thing that should have been flagged in testing.

97253.description:
Hey, got a sec?
So, apparently, nobody I've sent to deal with the recent pirate problem has come back alive. After five or six attempts I thought, "what if I sent a machine instead?" Turns out, scimitars double as screwdrivers in a pinch, and before I could redirect it home, it was already in pieces and scattered across their camp!
I need those parts back, and since this is a quick little retrieval mission, I'd wager your odds for survival are MUCH higher than the others. Whaddya say?
97253.name: Parts and Pieces
97253.objective: Collect 5 Handfuls of Complicated Parts from the upper pirate camp south of Ratchet, then return to Wrenix the Wretched in Ratchet.

comments.body: There is a faint trail going up the mountain on the right side of the road leading left from Anvilmar's front door (same road for mail delivery quest).  Follow the snowy trail past the first tree, and you'll see crates along the path. That path is steep, but climbable.  Go over the ridge, and the camp is in front of you. Kill the cat, find the book on the ground, and reverse your path out.
Take a moment and look at Ironforge in the distance once you find the camp.  Incredible they added a quest with this much ambiance.
Please, if you have any reverence for Final Fantasy VI open the book on the snowy ledge before turning it in. This is an amazing nod to the first scenes in Narshe.

Path starts at /way 26.0 68.7

Posted as it's own comment so it doesn't get buried.

97277.description:
Oi, had me back turned gettin' the boar roast ready when I heard me pal Gozwin screamin' fer his life!
Wicked fangs and a blur are all I saw when I turned. Such huge paws! A snow leopard was draggin' its gnomish catch away. I grabbed me shotgun and fired above the beast. It dropped him and sprinted off.
Luckily, it hadn't done more than give ol' Goz some deep scratches.
Head back to camp in the northwestern hills and retrieve Gozwin's Mechanic's Log. Kill that snow leopard too if you see it!
97277.name: Grund and Gozwin
97277.objective: Find Grund and Gozwin's camp in the hills to the northwest. Recover Gozwin's Mechanic's Log and kill the Snow Leopard Prowler.

comments.body:
This new quest teaches you how to reach Stormwind from Auberdine using the [b]new boat connection[/b].

The experience rewards for this chain are absolutely minuscule, but it's very much worth completing for the [item=282286] you'll receive after returning from the big city. This is the [b]best reagent bag you can obtain through questing[/b] [i](as of writing this)[/i]. You'll most likely be holding on to this until your [b]30s-40s[/b] [i]unless[/i] you go out of your way to buy a [item=253667] or [item=253973] (however, these are somewhat expensive investments due to the crafts requiring the use of [item=249409]).

For this quest, I recommend setting your [b]Hearthstone[/b] to [b]Auberdine[/b], then taking the boat to [b]Stormwind[/b] to complete the following objectives there:
[ol][li][quest=95065] (buy materials from [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=6301/gorbold-steelhand#map]Auberdine[/url])[/li]
[li][quest=97234] and the follow-up [quest=97237][/li]
[li][quest=97220] and the follow-up [quest=97222][/li]
[li][quest=7791] (if you have the capital...)[/li]
[li]Pay a visit to [npc=11867] for weapon training[/li][/ol]

You may also complete these if you wish, but know that they all only grant [b]10 XP[/b] at your level:
[ol][li][quest=332][/li]
[li][quest=333][/li]
[li][quest=334][/li][/ol]

Upon finishing up in Stormwind, simply [b]hearth back to Auberdine[/b] to turn this one in.

97914.description:
Auberdine is a humble place, <class>. You won't hear its name spoken in the boughs of Darnassus. Most reference only what the Sundering took from us--the thriving cities of Ameth'Aran, Bashal'Aran, and... Lathar'Lazal.
Yet Auberdine remains in their shadow.
I would see our work here recognized. A new vessel connects us to the kingdom of Stormwind, bringing life and supplies to our shores. I beseech you to join its next voyage, and bring this letter to a human called Baros Alexston.
Make our home known.
97914.name: Expanding Horizons
97914.objective:
Bring Thundris' Letter to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.
Thundris mentioned a boat in Auberdine that can take you there.

comments.body: [b]Best reagent bag outside of crafting.[/b] Well worth picking up as a new player, because the superior crafted bags all require somewhat expensive materials.

97926.description:
I wish it was that easy to help, <class>. I really do.
Should you choose to spend more time in our lands, you will find that many are without. Stormwind's coffers are not what they once were, and what remains is spread thin.
Give this reply to the elder the next time you see him. It's not what he's hoping for, but it's all I have to offer right now.
97926.name: Making Do
97926.objective: Bring Alexston's Reply to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine in Darkshore.

comments.body: 37,46 - Jumping distance from the platform with the hippogryph master

Buzzbox 827 is located near the flight master, in the grass. 
36 46

The Gnome questgiver is on the second floor of the inn, just up the ramp.

These quests also supply you with some good cooking ingredients, such as Crawler Meat and Claws, and Clam Meat. Plus the Gnomergan Exiles rep is pretty nice for such a low level quest thread.

This buzzbot was very hard to find. If you're stumbling around, he's almost directly at the south-west pier of the gryphon platform, just in the grass about 2-3 paces from the pier. He looks(especially in the dusk) just like a hillock of grass.
The crawler legs drop from the Pygmy Tide Crawlers
the buzzbox is at 37,46

Not a bad set of quests. When you complete all four you receive a total of 25 silver, 50 copper and 4300 XP.


B5

Wizbang is on the second floor of the Auberdine Inn. 

If you are inside where the Innkeeper, Fish Vendor, etc are...

There is a ramp that leads to two beds and the docks, right next to that is another ramp leading to the second floor and some more beds. He's right there by the beds on the second floor.
buzbox is at 36,46
>> Buzzbox 827 is just outside the south of Auberdine. It's very near to the platform where the Gryphon Master is located.

983.description:
Hey! Help me with my latest invention, the buzzbox. You can talk to people far away!
Maybe you've already seen them, they're boxes with levers on them. The only problem is they need constant maintenance.
Each one suffers from a different problem, but I made a really smart decision. I placed each one near creatures that have the proper parts to fix that particular machine. Right now Buzzbox 827 is on the fritz. It's just south of Auberdine, real close. It takes 6 Crawler Legs to fix it. I'll pay ya...
983.name: Buzzbox 827
983.objective: Collect 6 Crawler Legs and place them in Buzzbox 827.

comments.body:
Hey, this Sentinel [s]actually walks pretty fast[/s] is [b]just as slow as any other escort NPC[/b]! She ran all the way through the cave in the beta, but in live, she never breaks into stride at all. [b]But[/b] she deals good damage!

She spawns in the bottom layer of the cave system, in an alcove right next to where [npc=7318] patrols. You'll be walking all the way out of the cave with her, and when she reaches the road, the quest will be completed.

Before doing this, you may want to finish [quest=2541] and the next part [quest=2561] as well as [quest=483], as she's going to be moving out at a pretty quick pace. If you let her go too far away from you, the quest will fail.

[s]Also, I didn't pay any attention as to whether I received any XP/reputation doing this, but the database currently doesn't show it as giving any. That's quite odd. If there is no reward outside of the quiver/sword, camping for this escort might not actually be worth your time.[/s] [b]EDIT:[/b] As of launch, they've added a great XP reward.

This is genuinely the worst quest I have ever done across all Warcraft games, possible across all games, ever. There is 0 chance a human being has tried completing this quest on an actual server with other people. The NPC you're "escorting" goes haywire, targeting and running at mach 10 at every single hostile mob in the vicinity, doesn't matter if aggrod or not, then runs back to exactly where she first caught aggro.
My only advise I ever given on this website, skip this quest, save your sanity. It takes like 30 minutes. AND I FAILED RANDOMLY DURING IT. I wrote this review during this quest, I want to turn off the game I was excited all week to play.

She was almost out of the cave when a group of 3 people ran past through with like 7 mobs behind them making her aggro all of them, killing me and failing the quest.  :( Also why can't this quest be shared?
I received 850 XP when I completed this today at level 12. They must have fixed it.

The coordinates for those looking to start the quest are 44.7, 58.8.    

(Note that there is at least one other location in the tunnels where it will look like you are "on the exclamation point" but you are in a tunnel above the spawn point.) Also, the coordinates in the tunnels kind of dance around so it's hard to get there by following the coordinates. 

As to directions, You want to wind your way as far "north" in the caves as you can, to where Ravenclaw spawns and walks his circle around the pillar before he enters the tunnels.  You'll enter the cave where he circles with the pillar in the center, turn left, and immediately enter an alcove that looks very much the same as the alcoves where you found the items for "The Relics of Awakening."    If she's not there, someone's doing the quest.   (See the screenshot I posted for  coordinates and the map location.)

While waiting, you can clear Gnarlpine Defenders and Shaman outside the alcove to make the start a little easier.

As mentioned, she's aggressive about attacking mobs and as a result, it may take a couple of tries if there are other folks in the tunnels as she may bolt away from whatever you are fighting to follow mobs being dragged past you, causing you to fail the quest due to proximity.   Good luck!
I just finished doing this quest. She's slow, stops three times, and attacks anything in sight. Quest CAN be shared if you're in a group.

For some reason, her "Waiting on you." dialogue actually has an accompanying voice clip. None of her other dialogue does this.

also yeah, October 14th 2026, still not getting any exp from this quest.
About 10 minute respawn

So, yeah, world refresh happened while I was doing this quest, would not recommend, you have to follow her all the way up to the road outside of the den and she also does pit stops randomly on the way up where she just stands there  for 30 seconds. All in all the escort can take up to between 10-20 minutes to complete depending on how many mobs you have to kill.

99053.description:
My prayers have been answered! I am thankful that you have fought your way down here.
I was sent here by the Oracle Tree to deliver a message to the slumbering druids here only to find it completely overrun by furbolg! They ambushed me before I could turn back and brought me down here--I fear for their next meal.
I don't know about you, but I loathe this place. Under the earth is no place for the kaldorei.
99053.name: Escaping Ban'ethil
99053.objective: Help Sentinel Lynessa Duskblossom escape Ban'ethil Barrow Den, and report her safety to Sentinel Kyra Starsong in Dolanaar.
